mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{studentId} AND role_id=10 AND status='0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT notice_version FROM mood_notice_ack WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mood_notice_ack(student_id,notice_version) VALUES(#{studentId},#{version}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notice_version=VALUES(notice_version),accepted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id,student_id,DATE_FORMAT(week_start,'%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start,mood_level,private_note,note_shared,recording_key,recording_name,recording_mime,recording_size,CASE WHEN recording_key IS NOT NULL THEN id END AS recording_id,create_time FROM mood_entry WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND week_start=#{weekStart}

SELECT DISTINCT m.id,m.nick_name AS display_name,m.user_name AS username FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=e.course_id JOIN sys_user m ON m.id=c.mentor_id WHERE e.student_id=#{studentId} AND e.active=1 AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND m.role_id=20 AND m.status='0' ORDER BY m.id

SELECT s.id,s.nick_name AS display_name,s.user_name AS username FROM sys_user s WHERE s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' AND AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},s.user_name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},s.nick_name)>0) ORDER BY s.id

SELECT r.id,r.student_id,DATE_FORMAT(r.week_start,'%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start,r.mood_level,r.private_note,r.note_shared,r.recording_name,r.recording_mime,r.recording_size,CASE WHEN r.recording_key IS NOT NULL THEN r.id END AS recording_id,r.create_time FROM mood_entry r JOIN mood_notice_ack n ON n.student_id=r.student_id AND n.notice_version=#{version} WHERE r.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY r.week_start DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.week_start,'%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start,r.mood_level FROM mood_entry r JOIN mood_notice_ack n ON n.student_id=r.student_id AND n.notice_version=#{version} WHERE r.student_id=#{studentId} AND r.week_start BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY r.week_start

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.week_start,'%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start,r.mood_level,r.private_note AS diary_note,r.recording_name,r.recording_mime,r.recording_size,CASE WHEN r.recording_key IS NOT NULL THEN r.id END AS recording_id FROM mood_entry r JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=r.student_id WHERE s.id=#{studentId} AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' AND ORDER BY r.week_start DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.week_start,'%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start,r.mood_level FROM mood_entry r JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=r.student_id WHERE s.id=#{studentId} AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' AND AND r.week_start BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY r.week_start
